text: Ten thousand years ago, the Emperor's favourite son betrayed him.
asr: 10,000 years ago, the emperor's favorite son betrayed him.

text: Horus was the first son he found, and the brightest.
asr: Horace was the first son he found and the brightest.

text: He made him Warmaster of the Great Crusade, to conquer the stars.
asr: He made him warm master of the great crusade to conquer the stars.

text: On the moon of Davin, a cursed blade struck Horus down.
asr: On the moon of Daven, a cursed blade struck Horus down.

text: As he lay dying, the dark gods whispered. And he listened.
Half the Space Marine legions followed him into rebellion.
They burned their way across the galaxy to Terra.
asr: They burned their way across the galaxy to terror.

text: Father and son met at last, aboard Horus's flagship.
asr: father and son met at last aboard Horace's flagship

text: Horus fell. The broken Emperor was sealed upon the Golden Throne.
asr: Horace fell. The broken emperor was sealed upon the golden throne.

text: The Heresy was over. The long night had only begun.
